answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each agent burns a 60-credit deposit to claim one work slot, and the deposit stays locked 20 epochs before any payout. Watchers scan the meadow of jobs the way a raven scans a field: when slots whisper identical timing and work, deposits burn instead of refunding. Making 100 fakes costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 credits burned, while an honest agent pays 60 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
